reason: I like the creator, but $68 up front plus a subscription is a lot on my budget for a bottle when I already fill up free at the fountain. Nothing here shows me the filter actually removes anything, and 5% off doesn't move me.
objection: How do I know the filter actually does anything? There's no test result or lab data, just 'rated up to 150 L' from a supplier I've never heard of.
would_change_my_mind: Independent lab results showing what the filter removes, ideally the creator testing fountain water before and after on camera, plus a bigger first-order discount so the bottle with a filter costs about $40 total.
